messages:
maya (PM): quick intake: customers keep asking to run their own eval suites during rollouts. want a proposal for a customer-configurable eval-suite feature that runs in the control plane and can gate canaries.
maya (PM): problem — different customers have bespoke prompt sets, metrics, and pass/fail logic; they need results surfaced in the console and tied to a rollout decision.
maya (PM): goals: 1) customers upload eval bundle (prompts, expected outputs, metric defs). 2) run on canary and stable during rollouts. 3) surface results + diff + pass/fail. 4) support per-customer thresholds and automatic rollback.
maya (PM): non-goals: we won't provide managed labeling for customer private datasets, nor replace our curated public evals.
maya (PM): success metrics: 1) >= 30% enterprise rollouts use customer evals in first 6 months. 2) regression detections caught by customer evals (monitoring) >= 90% of time customer-defined failures.
josh (eng): +1. two big infra q's: storage format & privacy (where do uploads live?), and compute scheduling for eval runs.
josh (eng): can customers point to their S3/GCS or do they upload to Redwood? preferred is pointer + temporary access token.
anika (eng-ml): implementation sketch: accept JSONL bundles with records like {"prompt":..., "expected":..., "metric_tags":["exact_match","bleu","toxicity"]}. server runs suite against both canary/stable pods and computes per-metric deltas. sample config: ```{
 "eval_name": "refund-flow-v1",
 "records": "s3://acme-evals/refund-v1.jsonl",
 "metrics": [{"name":"pass_rate","threshold":0.92},{"name":"response_length_avg","direction":"lower"}]
}```
rachel (legal): must add PII guidance + required data processing agreement for any customer-uploaded prompts. retention TTL per-customer required.
samir (sales): customers asking specifically for ability to block rollouts automatically if their key metrics drop > X. this is a likely enterprise gate. good upsell.
li (design): UI notes: 1) "Upload eval" flow with schema validation + preview of first 10 records. 2) In rollout UI show a small eval card with pass/fail, delta sparkline, and link to full report. 3) allow setting threshold overrides per-rollout.
olga (eng-platform): rough effort: reuse eval harness from Optimize team but need tenant isolation & runner quotas. risks: spike in eval runs will affect capacity, need throttling & cost pass-through. also consider sandboxing to avoid model leakage.
olga (eng-platform): question — do we run evals synchronously in-canary path (blocking) or asynchronously with automatic rollback? both options have tradeoffs.
anika (eng-ml): recommend hybrid: run a fast smoke synchronous check (quick token-limited subset) for immediate blocking; schedule full async suite with timeout for delayed rollback & alerts.
josh (eng): agree. add a conservative default: smoke + async. require explicit opt-in for blocking rollouts using customer evals.
maya (PM): acceptance criteria (draft): - API + Console upload flow accepts eval bundles (JSONL or pointer). - Eval runs produce per-metric results and delta between variants. - Ability to set per-eval thresholds in rollout config. - Rollout can be configured to block automatically on threshold failure (opt-in). - Audit log entries for uploads, runs, and automated actions. - TTL & DPA controls enforced.
maya (PM): edge cases to call out: malformed records, non-deterministic expected outputs, very large bundles (>100k records), customers using copyrighted content.
rachel (legal): add requirement: default retention 30 days, configurable up to enterprise TOS, and option for customers to request deletion.
dev-bot: created INF-4821: "customer-eval-suites: intake + design + implementation" and linked to /roadmap/epics.
maya (PM): next steps: 1) eng & ml to produce feasibility doc + cost estimate. 2) legal to draft DPA addendum language. 3) design to prototype upload modal. 4) product to add to next prioritization sync. please comment if you disagree or have missing acceptance items. :eyes:
